pr_title: log-backup: use a worker pool to speed up read metafile set.
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/35530 Problem Summary: when we have 10000+ metafile from external_storage. This read I/O is becoming bottleneck, and other place like `log metadata` and `log truncate` will also benefit ### What is changed and how it works? use a worker pool to speed up the read progress. I set the pool size to 128, and this is enough for 1 week. ### Check List Tests - [x] Unit test - [ ] Integration test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) The time costs from 5mins -> 4.6s - [ ] No code Side effects - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory - [ ] Breaking backward compatibility Documentation - [ ] Affects user behaviors - [ ] Contains syntax changes - [ ] Contains variable changes - [ ] Contains experimental features - [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note None ```

issue_context.title: PiTR restore no progress update in console or log for a few minutes
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. Do PiTR restore

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7403864/174592476-8c74cffa-af32-4ee3-9b49-01d34fa6eb47.png)

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Progress info should be updated in time so that user can know that restore doesn't stuck.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```

[2022/06/18 15:13:19.915 +00:00] [INFO] [conn.go:257] ["new mgr"] [pdAddrs=dst-tidb-pd:2379]
```
